thread:
sophie: Quick FYI — I'm seeing a chain of broken example links in the Optimize toolkit docs (batching/caching/quant profiles). A bunch of SDK snippets still reference /examples/quant_profiles.json and old Go helper names. Can we do a quick sweep? Links reproducible: https://docs.internal/redwood/optimize/examples/quant_profiles.json :broken_link:

jamal: :eyes: I noticed that too after the last model swap. Probable culprit is that we renamed quant_profile -> profile_name in the manifest. I can grep the repo and open a PR for the samples.

maya: I can take the SDK snippets (go/js/python). Quick plan: update paths, update Go helper API usage, and add a one-line migration note under "Migration notes". Will ping reviewers.

sophie: Awesome. Prioritize batch/cache examples first — those are linked from the quickstart. Also add a minimal test that loads the sample via `curl` to the docs static host; we need a smoke check in CI.

docs-bot: Checklist created: 1) find orphaned links, 2) update snippets, 3) add migration note, 4) add smoke test, 5) PR labels. Link: https://inbox.docs/redwood/optkit-fixup-4356

raj: Please add a short blurb for release notes — customers who pinned quant profiles may need guidance. Also include whether fallback mapping exists (old->new).

maya: Draft PR opened: #4821. Changes: updated go example, renamed `quant_level` -> `quant_profile`, updated sample JSON path. Command to run the smoke check locally:
```
curl -fsS https://staging-docs.redwood/internal/optimize/examples/quant_profiles.json | jq .
```

jamal: I'll add a tiny unit test that loads the sample and asserts keys present. Will push to the same PR branch.

sophie: Can reviewers @anna and @liam take a look when ready? If green, let's merge and cherry-pick to stable and add a docs-announce with the migration note.

maya: pinged reviewers. tagging: @anna @liam :shipit:

sophie: Thanks y'all. Follow-up: let's also check embed examples that call `optimize.batch()` — edgecases for streaming + batching. I'll open a follow-up thread if I find more.

raj: Great coordination. :tada:
